# Checks

<!-- generated by `rmf checks-doc` from src/rmf_tool/check/registry.yaml; do not edit (INV-2) -->

72 rules: 36 repository-scope, 36 run-scope. Severity E fails the command, W warns. `Phase` is the phase from which a rule is enforced (`rmf ci --profile`); `After` is the task at which a run rule starts to apply outside `--final` (`-`: always). `Fixture` is the negative fixture or test that proves the rule fires.
